_why: Minimum ground alphas, the state/field overlay alphas and the edge mix the window-glass feature paints, derived by scripts/derive-glass-floors.mjs (AA ink over the worst measured backdrop WITH the state overlay stacked; the 3:1 structural edge via a border->ink mix). Asserted by scripts/contrast-contract.mjs. Never hand-lower a value: re-derive.

glassScale._why: The glass scale: tiers thin (lift 0, edge 0: the look that shipped), regular (these values: the default) and thick (reserved, not shipped). On light the pane inside <main> nets to alpha 0 (its target is below the canvas backing), so canvas -> pane is dE00 0.0; paneLift is added to the canvas alpha to form the pane's target, the smallest lift giving every light palette a dE00 1.5 step off the canvas at slider 40..100 over material greys 199 and 224. edgeMix is the ink share mixed into hairline for the 75% panel seam, the smallest giving dE00 3.0 against the three glass grounds at their floors. Dark is 0 for both (byte-identical). Derived by scripts/derive-glass-floors.mjs and asserted by scripts/contrast-contract.mjs; never hand-set.
